meta.title: Voz AI — AI front desk for your fleet, in Spanish and English
meta.description: Voz AI answers your fleet's phone, chat, email and SMS in Spanish and English on the same reservation record, and hands the mic to a person when it matters.

console.label: Sample of a call handled by Voz AI

0.value: Gracias por llamar a Ride Fleet. Soy la asistente virtual. ¿En qué te puedo ayudar?

1.value: Sí, buenas. Tengo una renta y quiero extenderla hasta el domingo.

2.value: Claro. Veo tu reserva RES-4821, el Corolla del aeropuerto. Extenderla dos días son $96 más peajes. ¿Te la extiendo?

3.value: Actually — sorry, can we do this in English? And does that ninety-six include the toll charges?

4.value: Of course. The $96 is the two extra rental days. Tolls are billed separately at cost from AutoExpreso — $11.40 so far on this rental.

5.value: Got it. One more thing — I was double charged last week. Can someone look at that?

6.value: I can extend the rental right now. The duplicate charge is a refund, so I am passing you to Marisol on the team — she has the record open.

channels.title: Four channels. One thread.
channels.aside: Each channel has its own rhythm. None has its own version of the truth: all four read and write the same record.

voice.body: Answers on the first ring — day, night, and when three calls come in at once. Quotes, looks up bookings and extends rentals by voice.

headers.touches: What it touches in the record

0.title: Booking and quotes
0.does: Checks availability, quotes with your rate rules and creates the booking.

1.title: After 5 PM
1.does: Answers what goes to voicemail today: hours, directions, changes and late returns.

2.title: Collections
2.does: Explains the breakdown, sends the payment link and logs the promise to pay.

3.title: Follow-up
3.does: Reminds on returns, confirms pickups and chases missing documents.

4.title: Exceptions
4.does: Stages the case with transcript and evidence, then stops. It does not decide.

spine.note: None of this happens in a separate database. Voz AI uses the same reservation record your counter sees, and the tolls it explains over the phone are the same ones Toll Bridge reconciles with AutoExpreso. One truth, four ways in.

check.v: Ask it about the tolls on a booking and compare with the invoice.

0.q: Does it sound like a robot?
0.a: Judge for yourself — that is what the number on this page is for. What we do promise is that it identifies itself as an assistant when it answers. We do not pretend it is a person.

1.q: What happens when it does not understand?
1.a: It escalates. When confidence drops, or the topic is a refund, a dispute or damage, it hands the call to a person with the transcript and record already open. It would rather transfer than improvise.

2.a: No. It eats the repetitive queue — hours, directions, booking status, reminders — so your team handles what actually needs judgement. The design is explicitly human-in-the-loop.

3.q: Does it work if I do not use Ride Fleet Manager?
3.a: Where it shines is on the operations spine, because there it can look up and write the record. If you run another system, let us talk about what can be connected before we sell you anything.

4.a: Spanish and English. Two. We do not say "any language" because it would not be true, and on a phone call that lie lasts about six seconds.

5.q: How long until it is answering?
5.a: If you already run Ride Fleet Manager it is configuration: your hours, your policies, your tone and the number. It is not an integration project. Exact timing depends on number provisioning with the carrier.
